tei:div.tei:p: tshe rabs ma lus thams cad du// bla ma dam pa mnyes byed cing*// mos gus ltem rkyang med pa dang*// nor bzang bzhin du bsten par shog /skyabs che byin che dkon mchog gsum// mchod pa'i tshogs ni ma lus pas// tshim pa med par mchod nas kyang*// rtag tu ngu bzhin bkur bar shog /bar chad thams cad sel 'gyur zhing*// ma bzhin sems pa'i yi dam lha// thun bzhi yis ni mnyes gyur pa// yi dam lha dang mi 'bral shog /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi 'brug sgra yis// dregs pa can rnams tshar gcod cing*// bstan pa ma lus bsrung ba yi// chos skyong rnams kyis bsrung bar shog /bdag cag lhan cig 'tshogs pa rnams// khro 'khrugs thams cad rab zhi zhing*// zab mo'i gtam ni sna tshogs kyis// sems la phan pa nyid du shog /gang du 'dug pa'i gnas rnams su// 'jigs dang nyam nga bral ba dang*// phyi nang 'tshe ba med pa yi// dgon gnas rnams dang mi 'bral shog /ngo srung brtsol ba mi dgos shing*// ngo bo nyid kyi chos la dkar// phan tshun 'tshe ba med pa yi// skye bo rnams kyis bkur bar shog /bdag kyang tshe rabs thams cad du// byams pa rgyun chad med pa dang*// rtogs pa gser gri chen po ltar// gnyis med 'gyur ba med par shog /nyon mongs gsum po skyes pa'i tshe// chu la ral gri btab pa bzhin// sems kyi mdud pa bral nas kyang*// 'od gsal ngang la gnas par shog /don med gleng slong zer ba'i tshe// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas// gtam gyi sbyor ba 'di rnams kyang*// chos kyi gtam du 'gyur bar shog /sdang ba'i yul rnams mthong ba'i tshe// rang dbang med par byams pa dang*// dang ba'i sems ni skye ba dang*// snying nas mar ni go bar shog /mdzes shing bkrag ldan mthong ba'i tshe// mi gtsang bum par go ba dang*// zhen pa'i mtshan ma rab log nas// chags pa med par gnas par shog /nga rgyal khengs shing dregs pa yi// skye bo rnams dang 'grogs pa na// smad pa'i mtshan ma rab log nas// bsnyen bkur byed par gnas gyur cig

/shes pa'i tshogs ni ma lus pas// ltem rkyang bral ba'i chos sku la// mos gus rgya chen byed pa dang*// gnyen po brtan par gnas par shog /sgrub pa byas pa'i 'bras bu des// rang gzhan gnyis kyi 'dod pa grub// 'khor ba mu mtha' med pa ru// sems can rnams la smin 'gyur shog// / ༄// seng ge'i 'grel chung bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so// oṃ swa sti// dge legs kyis rab tu rgyal bar gyur cig /rang byung 'od gsal byang chub sems kyi sku// dpal chen bdud 'joms ye shes mkhyen par ldan// chos rgyal bla med rnam grol 'khor los bsgyur// lha mi'i ston pa 'bri gung bzhugs la 'dud// zhing khams mi mjed padmo'i tshal dbus 'dir// 'dul mdzad ston pa thugs rje'i 'od phreng can// shākya'i rgyal po khri gdugs nyi ma shar// gzi brjid bde skyid dpal des phyogs bcur khyab// 'dir ltar nged bcag snyigs ma'i sems can thams cad kyis ston pa dang*/ skyabs dang 'dren pa gcig pur gyur pa/ bde bar gshegs pa dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa rnams la/ thabs mkhas shing thugs rje khyad par du 'phags pa/ bla na med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas lus can thams cad thar pa'i gzhal yas khang du kha lo bsgyur ba dang*/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ji snyed par mgon po rin po che rnam pa gsum mi zad pa'i gter chen po la mnga' mdzad pa// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa zhes phyogs bcur grags pa de 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir byon ste/ de yang sngon thog ma'i tshe/ yun ring po nas thugs bskyed rnam par dag pa yongs su rdzogs par ni gyur/ grangs med pa'i bskal par bya dka' ba'i mdzad pa 'bras bu dang bcas rlabs po che'i khur rnam pa shin tu mthar phyin pas/

sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor lhung ba/ yongs su skyob pa med pa rnams la/ dam pa'i chos bstan pa'i phyag rkyang bas ni rab tu ston/ nyon mongs pa'i mes rab tu brdungs pa rnams la 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i chu rgyun gyis shin tu bsil ba ni bgyis/ so so'i skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed cing yongs su smin la rnam par grol nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub rin chen gyi gling dam pa der 'god par mdzad pa'i/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis rab tu sngags zhing*/ khyad par du bkur la/ legs par bstod cing gsung dbyangs phyogs bcu'i zhing du sgrog par 'gyur ba lags na/ lha dang mi'i 'jig rten gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de la bdag cag bde bar gshegs pa thugs rje dang ldan pa de'i gdul rgyar gyur cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'khod pa'i bskal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyis/ 'dul mdzad ston pa de nyid kyi rigs mi 'chol bar 'gyur ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i don khong du chud par 'gyur ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i khungs gang lags pa khong du chud par 'gyur ba dang*/ gzhan gyis dring la mi 'jog par sku drin gzhal du med pa dran pa'i sgo nas byas pa bzo shing*/ mdzad pa dang gsung gi rjes su bsgrub par 'gyur ba dang*/ skyes bu dam pa mkhas par gyur pa rnams kyi rab tu mngags shing lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gzengs bstod par 'gyur ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ thos nas kyang dga' ba dang dad pa skyes pa tsam gyis rang gzhan gyi don chen po 'thob bo// zhes bsod nams kyi yon bshad par gyur pa dang*/ gnas 'di ni zang zing gis ma spags shing 'phags pa'i gtam/ shākya'i sras dge sbyong bsod nams pa bdag la'ang 'os shing*/ thub pa'i bstan pa gsal bar 'gyur ba'i slad du/ mdzad pa'i tshul dang*/ rim pa mdor bsdus pa'i yi ge 'go smos par bya ste/

de yang gang zhe na/ thog mar byang chub tu thugs bskyed cing brtse ba chen pos zhing 'di bzung ba'i mdzad pa dang gcig bar du dka' ba spyod pa rlabs po ches thub pa'i dbang po'i gsung rab 'di yang dag par bsgrub pa'i mdzad pa dang gnyis/ mthar 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya ba'i mdzad pa dang gsum mo// thog mar byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa'i mdzad pa la don gnyis te/ kun nas yongs su snang ba'i thugs bskyed pa dang gcig bla mar gyur pa'i mchog gis thugs bskyed pa dang gnyis so// yongs su snang ba la'ang gnyis/ 'dul ba'i sde snod las ji ltar snang ba dang*/ mdo sde'i sde snod las ji ltar snang ba rnam pa gnyis so// bla mar gyur pa mchog la don lnga te/ dus gang gi tshe thugs bskyed pa dang gcig sku skye ba ji ltar bzhes pa gnyis/ ston pa gang gi drung dang gsum/ tshul ji ltar bskyed pa dang bzhi/ thugs bskyed pas khyad par du ji ltar 'phags pa dang rnam pa lnga'o// bar du thub pa'i dbang po'i gsung rab yang dag par bsgrubs pa'i mdzad pa la don bdun te/ ltos med mi zad sbyin pas bsgrubs pa'i mdzad pa dang gcig gtsang ma'i tshangs spyod tshul khrims kyis bsgrubs pa'i mdzad pa dang gnyis/ zhi dul des pa bzod pas bsgrub pa'i mdzad pa dang gnyis/ ma zhum mi skyo brtson 'grus kyis bsgrub pa'i mdzad pa dang bzhi/ ting nge 'dzin rtse gcig bsam gtan gyis bsgrub pa'i mdzad pa dang lnga/ rnam 'byed don rtogs shes rab kyis bsgrub pa'i mdzad pa dang drug de dag mthar son pa'i bsgrub pa'i mdzad pa dang rnam pa bdun no// mthar 'bras bu phun tshogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa la don rnam pa gsum ste/ gang gis 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dbang phyug dang 'byor pa zil gyis mnan pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa dang gcig gang gis 'jig rten gyi khams dka' thub dang brtul zhugs zil gyis mnan pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dang gnyis/

gang gis 'jig rten gyi khams kyis sdig pa can gyis dpung zil gyis gnon pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa dang rnam pa gsum mo// ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i mdzad pa dang po la lnga ste/ dga' ldan du bzhugs pa'i mdzad pa dang gcig lhums su zhugs pa'i mdzad pa dang gnyis/ sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa dang gsum/ gzhon nu rol rtsed gyi mdzad pa dang bzhi/ btsun mo'i 'khor bsten pa'i mdzad pa dang rnam pa lnga'o// dga' ldan na bzhugs pa'i mdzad pa la don gnyis ste/ gnas skabs de nyid na bzhugs pa'i mdzad pa dang gcig mtha' thug thugs kyi dgongs pa'i mdzad pa dang rnam pa gnyis so// thugs kyis dgongs pa'i mdzad pa la'ang don gnyis te/ dgongs pa'i rgyu mtshan bskul ba'i dam bcas pa'i spyi don dang gcig rgyu mtshan dang ldan pa'i mdzad pa bye brag gi don dang rnam pa gnyis so// mdzad pa bye brag gi don la gsum/ mchog dang mchog ma yin pa'i khyad par bstan pa'i phyir 'dzam bu'i gling du rig byed bzhag pa'i mdzad pa dang gcig sus kyang rgol bar mi nus shing legs par spyad pa 'bras bu dang bcas pa bstan pa'i mdzad dang gnyis/ lha rnams la legs par gdams shing rgyal tshab dbang bskur ba'i mdzad pa dang rnam pa gsum mo// lhums su zhugs pa'i mdzad pa la lnga ste/ khyad par can gyis snga ltas bstan pa dang gcig zhum 'bring ba'i rnam 'phrul dang gnyis/ sku gzugs kyis rnam pa ji lta bu dang gsum/ lhums na ji ltar zhugs pa dang bzhi/ 'phrin las ji lta bu mdzad pa dang lnga'o// ji ltar zhugs pa'i tshul la ya mtshan gyi mdzad pa lnga dang ldan te/ sdug bsngal dang bral zhing bde blag tu zhugs pa ya mtshan du che ba dang gcig rnam par dag cing gtsang bar zhugs pa ya mtshan du che ba dang gnyis/ srung ma dang bcas te bar chad med par zhugs pa ya mtshan du che ba dang gsum/ sku yongs su rdzogs te ma tshang bar med par zhugs pa ya mtshan du che ba dang bzhi/

mngon gsum du mthong zhing sgrib pa med par zhugs pa ya mtshan du che ba dang rnam pa lnga'o// phrin las kyi mdzad pa sgo rnam pa bzhi dang ldan te/ mun tshogs 'joms pa sgron me'i sgo dang gcig chos kyi 'khor lo rnam grol gyi sgo dang gnyis/ zug rngu sel ba sman gyi sgo dang gsum/ thabs mkhas phan 'dogs gnyen bshes kyis sgo dang bzhi'o// 'dren pa sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa la don gsum te/ bkra shis 'byor ldan gyi dus gang lags pa dang gcig sa phyogs yid 'ong gi gnas gang lags pa dang gnyis/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i bltams tshul gang lags pa dang gsum mo/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i bltams tshul la lnga ste/ lha mi'i 'jig rten dpang por gyur cing gnod pa dang rtsod pa dang bral nas khyad par du 'phags pa dang gcig mi shig pa rdo rje'i sku mnyes pas seng ge'i rtsal bstan cing seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa khyad par du 'phags pa dang gnyis/ rnam par rol pa'i cho 'phrul gyis ya mtshan gyi bkod pa bstan pa khyad par du 'phags pa dang gsum/ skye dgu'i bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub ste don dang ldan pa'i mtshan rtsol ba khyad par du 'phags pa dang bzhi/ gzhung smra ba'i mkhyen pa dang mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i gzigs pas mi 'gyur ba'i lung bstan pa khyad par du 'phags pa dang lnga'o// gzhon nu rol rtsed kyi mdzad pa la don gsum ste/ brjod bya'i don dang rjod byed kyi sgra gsal bar byed pa yi ge'i rig byed bstan pa'i rol rtsed dang gcig tshad grangs kyi dbye ba bstan la 'bebs par byed pa rtsis kyi rig byed bstan pa'i rol rtsed dang gnyis/ sku'i mthu stobs sgyu rtsal phun gsum tshogs pa bstan pa'i rol rtsed dang rnam pa gsum mo// sgyu rtsal bstan pa la don gsum ste/ zhabs mthe bong gis mthu rtsal bstan pa dang gcig phyag sor mo'i mthu rtsal bstan pa dang gnyis/ 'phong la sogs pa'i mthu rtsal bstan pa dang gsum mo// btsun mo'i 'khor bstan pa'i mdzad pa la don gsum ste/

khyad par can gyi dgos byed gang lags pa dang gcig khab tu bzhes tshul gang lags pa dang gnyis/ khab na bzhugs pa'i tshul gang lags pa dang gsum mo// dgos khyad la rnam pa gnyis te/ gzhan la phan pa rgya chen po bsgrub pa dang*/ sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyi rjes su 'jug pa'o// bzhugs pa'i tshul la che ba'i yon tan rnam pa bzhi dang ldan ste/ pho brang dam pa gnas kyi che ba'i yon tan dang gcig phun sum tshogs pa longs spyod kyi che ba'i yon tan dang gnyis/ 'khor los bsgyur ba rgyal srid kyi che ba'i yon tan dang gsum/ zhi ba chags bral lha chos kyi che ba'i yon tan dang bzhi'o// de ltar btsun mo'i 'khor bstan pa'i mdzad pa dang gcig gzhon nu rol rtsed kyi mdzad pa dang gnyis/ sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa dang gsum/ lhums su zhugs pa'i mdzad pa dang bzhi/ dga' ldan du bzhugs pa'i mdzad pa dang lngas ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa dang po bstan pa'o// ༈ //ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i mdzad pa gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sku rab tu gshegs pa'i mdzad pa dang gcig dka' ba spyad pa'i mdzad pa dang gnyis/ byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa'i mdzad pa dang gsum mo// rab tu gshegs pa'i mdzad pa la don gsum ste/ 'phags pa'i tshogs dang lha'i tshogs kyis bskul ba'i don dang gcig thugs dgongs lhag pa'i bsam pa g.yo ba med pa'i mthu rtsal bstan pa'i don dang gnyis/ dka' thub kyi rtsal du rang byung gi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i don dang gsum/ dang po bskul ba la gsum ste/ rol mo sil snyan gyis sgras bskul ba dang gcig mi rtag pa'i snang bas bskul ba dang gnyis/ rnam grol gyi gnas tshangs par spyod pa'i bskul ba dang gsum mo// lhag bsam gyi mthu rtsal bstan pa la gnyis/ sa steng skye bo 'dod ldan gyi dpung tshogs mgo rmongs par bgyis pa dang gcig gtsang ma'i lha la sogs pa dkar po'i phyogs kyi dpung tshogs kyis zhabs 'bring bgyis pa dang gnyis so// bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i don la gnyis ste/

dge slong gi yo byad ci ltar bzhes pa dang gcig dge slong gi spyod pa ji ltar mdzad pa dang gnyis so// dka' ba spyad pa'i mdzad pa la don nyer gnyis/ dka' thub can gyi man ngag mngon du mdzad pa dang gcig dka' ba spyad pa'i tshul ji lta bu bstan pa dang gnyis/ dka' ba spyad pa'i dgongs pa gang yin pa dang gsum mo// dka' ba spyad pa'i tshul la lnga ste/ gnas dang gcig 'tsho ba dang gnyis/ ting nge 'dzin dang gsum/ spyod lam dang bzhi/ yun ji srid pa dang lnga'o// byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa'i mdzad pa la don lnga ste/ ngal zhing dub pa sbyor ba'i mtha' spang ba'i mdzad pa dang gcig byang chub snying por gshegs pa'i shul ji ltar brgyan pa'i mdzad pa dang gnyis/ gang yang 'jig rten gyis mun pa 'thibs po'i gnas snang bar byed pa dang gsum/ chos kyi bde ba dang rjes su mthun pa'i gdan bzhes pa'i mdzad pa dang bzhi/ rdo rje'i gdan de la ji ltar bzhugs pa'i mdzad pa dang lnga'o// de ltar byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa'i mdzad pa dang gcig dka' ba spyad pa'i mdzad pa dang gnyis/ sku rab tu gshegs pa'i mdzad pa dang gsum gyis ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa gnyis pa bstan pa'o// ༈ //ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i mdzad pa gsum pa la/ don bla na med pa rnam pa gsum ste/ bdud kyi sde 'joms pa'i mdzad pa bla na med pa dang gcig rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa bla na med pa dang gnyis/ chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba'i mdzad pa bla na med pa dang gsum/ bdud sde bcom pa'i mdzad pa la gsum/ bdud kyis go bar mdzad pa dang gcig bdud sde ji ltar lhags pa dang gnyis/ 'joms par mdzad pa nyid dang gsum mo// 'joms par mdzad pa nyid la/ mthar phyin pa'i mdzad pa lnga ste/ sku'i gzi brjid mthar phyin pas bdud sde bcom pa dang gcig gsung gi sgra dbyangs mthar phyin pas bdud sde bcom pa dang gnyis/ thugs kyi dgongs pa mthar phyin pas bdud sde bcom pa dang gsum/

yon tan gyi bkod pa mthar phyin pas bdud sde bcom pa dang bzhi/ 'phrin las kyi rol pa mthar phyin pas bdud sde bcom pa dang lnga'o// rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa la gsum ste/ thugs gang la mnyam par bzhag cing ji ltar thugs su chud pas sangs rgyas pa dang gcig dus kyi rgyal po gang gi tshe sangs rgyas pa dang gnyis/ sangs rgyas nas rnam par 'phrul pa ji lta bu bstan pa dang gsum mo// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mdzad pa la don gsum ste/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i don dang gcig chos kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bskor ba'i don dang gnyis/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba cho 'phrul dang bcas pa'i don dang gsum mo// ji ltar bskor ba'i don la phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga ste/ bla na med pa'i ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dang gcig don chen 'grub pa dus kyi phun sum tshogs pa dang gnyis/ mchog gi bstan pa gnas kyi phun sum tshogs pa dang gsum/ skal ldan gdul bya 'khor gyi phun sum tshogs pa dang bzhi/ thog mthar dge ba chos kyi phun sum tshogs pa dang lnga'o// chos kyi 'khor lor cho 'phrul dang bcas pa'i don la bzhi ste/ yongs su grags pa'i cho 'phrul chen po grong khyer gnyan yod du bstan pa dang gcig cho 'phrul chen po grong khyer gsal ldan du bstan pa dang gnyis/ yongs su grags pa'i cho 'phrul chen po grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu bstan pa dang gsum/ yongs su grags pa'i cho 'phrul chen po grong khyer yangs pa can du bstan pa la sogs pa dang rnam pa bzhi'o// de ltar chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mdzad pa dang gcig rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa dang gnyis/ bdud sde bcom pa'i mdzad pa dang gsum gyis ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa gsum pa bstan pa'o// ༈ //dgung lo'i skabs kyang smos par bya ste/ yab rgyal po'i pho brang du thub pa dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi bar du bzhugs so// de nas dgung lo drug gi bar btsun mo'i 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs so// gang yang thub pa dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu bzhes pa'i tshe rab tu gshegs so// de nas dgung lo drug gi bar du dka' thub kyi 'tshal du bzhugs te/

gang yang thub pa dgung lo sum cu rtsa lnga bzhes pa'i tshe rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen po brnyes so// de nas dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe bdun gyi bar du chos kyi 'khor lo cho 'phrul dang bcas pa bskor zhing bstan pa mdzad do// gang yang thub pa dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du 'tsho zhing bzhes so// de ltar ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa rnam pa gsum gyis/ mthar 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa bstan to// de'i gong du bya dka' ba'i spyod pas thub pa'i dbang po'i gsung rab 'di yang dag par bsgrub pa'i mdzad pa ston to// de'i gong du byang chub tu thugs bskyed cing brtse ba chen pos zhing 'di bzung ba'i mdzad pa bstan to// de ltar rnam pa gsum gyis/ nged kyis ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten du byon pa'i mdzad pa'i rim pa dag 'go smos pa'i tshig gis brjod pa yin la/ de'i gong du brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan rnam pa bdun dang bcas ste bstan pa lags so// de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang sangs rgyas kyi rnam par rol pa dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul de dag zhib mo dang*/ rgyas par ni mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa'i drin thob cing*/ ston pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho nyid kyis rjes su 'brangs nas/ yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis mig dang*/ phyin phyi ma log pa'i blo gros kyis rtogs shing khong du chud par byas te/ ji srid sems can gyi khams dang*/ chos kyi dbyings dang*/ de bzhin nyid mnyam zhing*/ skyon thams cad dang bral ba dang*/ yon tan mthar phyin pa dang*/ lhun gyis grub cing rgyun mi 'chad par gtsang ba dang dam pa'i bdag dang*/ bde ba dang*/ rtag pa'i sku mya ngan las mi 'da' ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo nub par mi 'gyur ba dang*/ rgyal sras dge 'dun gyi tshogs rgyun mi 'chad cing*/
'gro ba thams cad kyi 'dren pa kho nar bzhugs pa nyid du rig par bya bas

gangs can/ 'di ni dge sbyong bsod nams pa chos dang ldan pa'i gtam ci 'byor pa dag lags so// e ma ho/ 'dzam gling byang phyogs ri rgyud 'di ru/ shākya seṅge'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i tshe// chog shes sbyangs sdom 'phags pa'i rtsal rdzogs shing*// tshangs spyod chos sgra sgrog la yi rang ngo*// ngo mtshar gnas 'dir dang ba'i sems bskyed nas// snyan pa'i tshig gis don 'di brjod pa'i mthus// 'gro rnams go 'phangs gya nom skal ldan zhing*// mthar phyin rgyal ba'i mdzod la dbang bsgyur shog /nged kyis ston pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i bla ma dam pa des/ 'jig rten du byon pa'i mdzad pa'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa/ don grub dga' ston gyi bsti zhes bya ba/ shākya'i dge slong bsod snyoms pa shes rab dpal gyis yi ger bris la/ bkra shis shing rtag tu dge bar gyur cig/ yi ger bkod pa'i sgros 'di yul skad dang*/ gang gis rjes su 'brangs pa ma yin te/ thub pa'i dbang po nyid kyi bka' lung gtsug lag las ji ltar byung ba dang tshul mthun pa bgyis pas/ tshig gi sgros gzhan gyis mi slad pa dang*/ tshig shad gyis dbang bskal ci dgar mi bya bar/ tshig khrid dang*/ tshig shad dang*/ tshig phrag phyed pa dang*/ gcig shad dang gnyis shad dang*/ bzhi shad 'di ji ltar phye ba bzhin du slob ma rnams kyis kyang*/ 'di kho na ltar 'bri ba bzhugs so// zhu dag/ shubhoṃḥdage'o// // ༄// rje'i tshig gsum gnad kyi gdams pa// lhun gyis grub cing 'dus ma byas// spros pa'i mtshan ma mi mnga' zhing*// dag pa gnyis ldan chos kyi sku// rin chen bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// de yi zhal nas legs gsungs pa// bdud rtsi gnad kyi man ngag 'di// gus bsten slob mas skul phyir ni// brtse bas man ngag gsung bzhin bri/ bu gcig gus pas tshur nyon dang*// rnyed dka' ba'i dal 'byor thob pa 'di// mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil pa 'dra// de phyir tshe 'di'i 'dun pa spongs// rigs drug 'khor ba'i du khaḥl// me dong lta bur bsams lags nas// de las thar byed dam pa'i chos// gnas lugs don la goms par mdzod// 'khor ba'i rgyud las thar lags kyang*// brtse ba'i ma rnams bor lags na// nyan rang dman pa'i byang chub yin// sems gsum 'bral med sgom zhig gsungs// tshe 'di don chen sgrub lags na// tshad ldan bla ma rin chen gyi// ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrub pa yin// dngos grub 'byung gis mos gus gyis// rang gzhan don 'byung rdzogs sangs rgyas// sgrub byed gnad kyi man ngag ni// zung 'jug lam gyi mchog gyur pa// tshig gsum gnad kyi man ngag 'di ltar bya gsung*/

sangs rgya rnams kyi gzhung lam 'di// tshe 'di'i ltos thag bcad nas kyang*// nyams len 'bras med brtson 'grus kyis// snying la zhog gcig skyes bu rnams// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'o skol gyi ston pa thub pa chen po mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ sems can gyi nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa yin/ chos de rnams nyams su len pa la tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa cig gsungs na yang mdor bsdus nas/ paṇḍi ta sgro 'dogs phyi nas gcod pa dang*/ ku sā li sgro 'dogs nang nas gcod pa gnyis yin ste/ de yang paṇḍi ta sgro 'dogs phyi nas gcod pa bya ba ste/ bshad pa'i bla ma mang po bsten/ bka' bstan bcos sam mdo sde dang*/ rgyud sde rnams la thos bsam gyis shes bya bskyangs pas nam zhig na/ chos rnams nam mkha' phyis brtas chos su 'gro bar gsungs pa mi 'dug pas/ bsgoms pa med kyang ci zhig ltar la shes pa kha nang du log ste sems lhan cig skyes pa'i don rtogs nas rtog pa 'char ba yang yod par 'dug gsung*/ gnyis pa ku sā li sgro 'dogs nang nas gcod pa'i lugs ni/ chos mang po gcig thos bsam ma byas kyang*/ bla ma dam pa gcig dang mjal/ mos gus byas te gsung rdog po gcig tsam la gtsigs su byas nas bsgoms pas/ bla ma'i byin rlabs dang rang gi mos gus kyi shugs kyis rang gi sems lhan gcig skyes pa skye 'chi med pa'i don rtogs de/ rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa shar ba'i dus su/ bka' sde snod kyi don ma lus pa khong du chud bcing snang ba dpe char 'char ba yin/ de tsa na paṇḍi ta mang pos mtha' bskor yang*/ chos kyi lan 'debs pa la thogs pa med cing nyam nga med pa 'byung*/ de la sgom 'byung gi shes rab zer ba yin la/ rnal 'byor pa seng ge lta bu bya ba yang de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin gsung*/

'o na de lta bu rang e yod dam snyam na yod de slob dpon birwa pa lta bu'am/ tog rtse lta bu yin/ bla ma nā ro pas tilli pa mnyes par byas pa la brten nas/ nā ro pa'i thugs la tshig don ma lus pa dus gcig la 'khrungs pa yin gsung*/ de ltar lugs gnyis las 'o skol gyi bka' brgyud rin po che 'di ku sā li sgro 'dogs nang nas gcod pa'i lugs yin gsung*/ de yang nged ku sā li pa yin zer nas/ gdams chung 'ga' re yi ger bris nas/ de dar gyis dkris/ mchan khung bse dri kha shos gcig tu bcug nas/ 'di na su la yang med pa'i gdams pa yod pa yin zer ba de la ku sā li pa mi zer/ 'o na gang yin na rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos gcig nyams su blangs pas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la go rtogs skye ba gcig byung na de ku sā li pa bya ba yin gsung*/ chos gcig nyams su blangs na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad go nus pa'i chos de gang yin snyam na/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ de tshig nyung la don 'dril ba nyams su blang bde ba/ tshig rdog po gsum las med kyis khyed kyis 'di blo la zung la nyams su longs gsung*/ de gang yin na/ lus 'di tsug sdod la sems 'di tsug zhog dang*/ yon tan 'di 'dra zhig skye yis bya ba gsum po 'di las med pa yin gsung*/ 'di la yang sangs rgyas kyi chos re re lus sems kyi bzhag thabs mi 'dra ba re re/ de rnams la yon tan gyi skye tshul tha dad pa re re ste bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig gsungs pa yin te/ da res phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan lta bu gcig la mtshon na/ gsum yin te/ dngos po'i gnas lugs dang*/ lam nyams su len pa'i thabs dang*/ 'bras bu skye ba'i tshul dang gsum las/ dngos po'i gnas lugs ni lus 'di gdod ma nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'am da la'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas gcig yin te/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ sa chu spyan dang ma mā kī// dkar dang sgrol ma zhes bya ba// me dang rlung du rab tu grags// rdo rje skye mched nyid dag kyang*// byang chub sems pa'i da la'i mchog

/ces gsungs pas shes la/ sems kyi rang bzhin ni gdod ma nas rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi sku sangs rgyas yin te/ 'da' ka ye shes nas/ sems rtogs na sangs rgyas yin pas/ sangs rgyas gzhan du mi btsal ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o// gsungs pa yin/ lus sems gnyis kyi gnas lugs 'di rtogs na sangs rgyas yin la/ ma rtogs na 'khor ba'i sems can yin te/ dbu ma nas/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gnyis su yod pa ma yin te// 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid shes pa la// mya ngan 'das zhes brjod pa yin// gsungs pas/ gnas lugs des ma phan par de mngon du gyur par byed pa la/ lam thabs nyams su blangs pa'i rim pa gsungs pa yin pas/ lus 'di tsug sdod la/ sems 'di tsug zhog dang*/ zhes pa 'di gsungs pa yin/ 'o na lus ci tsug 'jog pa yin snyam na/ bla mas bstan pa 'di tsug 'jog pa yin/ bla mas bstan pa gang yin na/ bsam gtan gyi 'khrul 'khor gnad brgyad dang ldan par 'jog pa yin te/ rkang pa dkyil krung bca' ba dang*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag bya ba dang*/ sgal tshigs srang ba dang*/ yang mgrin pa dgu bar bya/ mig sna rtser dbab/ lce rkan la sbyar/ dbang po thur du 'chang ba/ dpung pa rgod gshog bzhin yangs par bya ste/ lus gnad brgyad po de las ma g.yos par sdod pa de la lus 'di tsug sdod bya ba zer ba yin gsung*/ sems 'di tsug zhog dang bya ba sems ci tsug 'jog pa yin snyam na/ sems bla mas bstan pa de tsug 'jog pa yin te/ gang yin na phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan du 'jog pa la zer ba yin pas lus de tsug gtad nas/ dang po byams pa dang snying rje/ byang chub kyi sems kyi steng du ma yengs par sing nge 'jog pa yin/ gnyis pa de'i rjes la rang gi lus yi dam gyi lha'i steng du brgyan la sogs pa gsal bar 'jog pa yin/ gsum pa de'i rjes la lus khong stong snying pad ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte ba la rtsa ba'i bla ma gsal bar bsgom/

bzhi pa blo snga phyi'i bar der bla mas bstan pa bzhin du sems de bzhin nyid ma bcos pa'i ngang du 'jog pa yin te/ de ltar bzhag pas sems rnam par mi rtog pa de'i ngang du gnas kyin 'dug na/ de skye ba med pa'i sgo bye ba yin pas/ de la dga' ba mi bya ba bar gnas tshad du bzhag de la mi gnas par rnam rtog sna tshogs su skye na 'gag pa med pa'i sgo bye ba yin pas/ de la mi dga' ba mi bya bar byang chub kyi sems dang*/ yi dam dang bla ma bsgom mo// sems mi rtog pa la mi gnas par rtog pa skye/ rtog pa la yang mi gnas par 'phro na/ gnas pa med pa'i sgo bye ba yin pas/ chags sdang mi bya bar gang byung yon tan du shes par byas la/ sems ma bcos pa la bzhag lnga pa bsngo ba zhe thag pa nas bya/ de sems 'di tsug bya bya ba yin/ de ltar lam lnga ldan nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras bu'i 'byung tshul ni/ yon tan 'di 'dra gcig skye yis bya ba yin gsung*/ yon tan ci 'dra gcig skye na bla mas bstan pa'i lus sems gnyis kyi dge sbyor skye ba de/ de yang dang po lus de ltar bzhag pas lus kyi yon tan gcig skye/ rkang pa dkyil krung bcas pas zas mi 'ju ba mi 'ong*/ kha smras kyi bar du mi tshugs/ gnad des sa rlung la gnad du 'gro zhing*/ sa rlung dbang du 'du ba'i yon tan 'byung ba dang*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag byas pas/ me rlung la gnad du 'gro zhing*/ me rlung dbang du 'du ba'i yon tan 'byung ba dang*/ gnad des bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'byung ba yin/ tshigs srang pa dang*/ dpung pa yangs par byas pas/ khyab byed kyi rlung la gnad du 'gro zhing dbang du 'dus rlung rang gnas su tshud pas/ rtsa zug rlung zug snying zug yong ba'i skyon mi 'byung pa/ mgrin pa dgu bar byas pas rtse mgo mnan pas/ rlung gi rlung la gnad du 'gro zhing*/ dbang du 'dus pa'i yon tan 'byung*/ mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye'o/

rlung gis rlung la gnad du 'gro zhing*/ dbang du 'dus pa'i yon tan 'byung*/ mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye'o/ lce rkan la sbyar ba dang*/ dbang po thur du 'phyang pas/ chu rlung la gnad du 'gro zhing dbang du 'dus pa yin/ kha chu sne chu mi 'byung ngo*// mig sna rtser phab pas nam mkha'i rlung la gnad du 'gro zhing*/ dbang du 'dus pa yin/ des gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye'o// yang 'khrul 'khor de la gnas pas lus ngag mi dge ba bdun spongs pas/ spong ba bdun gyi tshul khrims 'ong ste/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab par 'ong*/ lus gnad des rtog pa gzhan du ma spangs pas lhag pa sems kyi bslab par 'ong*/ lus sems gnyis stong par shes pa'i lus gnad re la/ yon tan dang skyon skyed par shes pa'i dus su lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab par 'ong gsung*/ yang 'khrul 'khor la gnad du bsnun pas gnas skabs dang mthar thug thams cad du/ byang chub snying po la byon nas sangs rgyas pa'i 'khrul 'khor nas bzung nas/ tha ma gnyid log pa'i lus gnad kyi bar du lus gnad tha dad pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don 'byung ba ni sprul pa'i sku yin/ lus gnad des lus la thig le gnas pas/ rang bzhin bde ba chen por longs spyod pa'i lhar shar ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don 'byung ba ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin la/ 'khrul 'khor de la gnad du bsnun pas/ sems spros pa mtha' thams cad dang bral ba chos kyi skur rtogs pa ni/ chos kyi sku'i sangs rgyas yin te/ 'jam dpal nas/ rdo rje dkyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas// zhes gsungs pa de lta bu yin gsung*/ de nas sangs rgyas sangs rgyas pa'i dus su yang lus gnad de nyid kyis don grub par mdzad la yin/ de'i dus su phyag g.yas pa nam mkha' la ma bslang ste/ sa gnon mdzad nas sangs rgyas pa yin te/ de la dgos pa khyad par can gcig yod par 'dug gsung*/

des mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad lus gnad du go ba bya ba de lta bu yin la/ yang lus g.yas su yo na zhe sdang skye zhing pho gdon gyis bar du gcod/ g.yon du yo na chags pa skye zhing mo gdon gyis bar du gcod/ rgyab tu dgye na klu btsan gyis bar du gcod/ mdun du dgu na gti mug skye zhing sa bdag gis bar du gcod/ de ltar dug gsum skyed pas lus ngag yid gsum gyis la sogs pas/ rigs drug tu rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi tshul du 'khor bar 'khyams par shes pa ni 'khor ba'i 'dug lugs go ba yin te/ mtshan brjod las/ lus med lus de lus kyi mchog /lus kyi mtha' ni rtogs pa po// zhes gsungs pa yang*/ de lta bu yin gsung*/ des na lus gnad re res 'khor 'das kyi byung tshul tha dad pa bskyed par shes pa'i dus su/ gsang ba rten 'brel lus gnad shes pa bya bar 'ong*/ yang der 'khrul 'khor gyi yon tan thob pas 'khrul 'khor gyi dngos grub bya ba yong ba yin gsungs/ de tsa na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad lus gnad kyi 'khor lo gcig pu go bas chos thams cad go ba yin pas chos chung ba min gsung*/ nang rten 'brel lus kyi 'khrul 'khor du go ba'i dus su/ dge sbyor ci byas pa thams cad lus gnad du go ba dang*/ phyi'i snang ba thams cad lus gnad du go ba ste/ bsam pa des gsang ba rten 'brel lus byin gyi rlabs nas lus de 'khrul 'khor gyi lus sam/ rten 'brel gyi sku bya ba gcig tu gyur pa'i dus su/ lta stangs la sogs lus kyi gnad re res sems can gyi gnad re res sems can gyi don mang po 'grub pa dang*/ rang gi lus mthong ba tsam gyis gzhan gyi yon tan bskyed bcing skyon sel bar nus pa 'byung gsung*/ gsang ba rten 'brel snang ba byin gyis rlabs pa'i dus su/ rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs mngon du gyur pa yin bya ba'i snyan pa byung nas/

gzhan gyi bsnyen bkur byed pa 'ong*/ 'khrul 'khor gtsigs su byed pa'i 'khor 'dus nas rang gi don grub 'ong ba dang*/ gang tu phyin pa thams cad du 'khrul 'khor gyi 'phrin las bzhi'i sgo nas sems can smin grol byed pa 'byung te/ de chos che ba yin gsung*/ gnyis pa sems lnga ldan gyi steng du bzhag pa'i ston ni/ dang po byang chub kyi sems kyi steng du sems bzhag pa'i yon tan ni/ byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa'i dus su/ chags sdang la sogs pa'i rtog pas ma btses par lus sems bde ba ni bde ba/ gzhan don du gsal ba ni gsal ba/ byang chub kyi sems de gsal kyang de las gzhan pa'i rtog pa med pa ni/ mi rtog par 'ong gsungs/ yang bsam pa byang chub kyi sems des zhe sdang la sogs pa'i rtog pa spangs pa ni tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ gzhan don de'i steng na sems gnas pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa yin/ bsam pa bzang po re res 'phrin las/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'grub par shes pa'am/ sems stong pa nyid don dam pa byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin du rtog pa ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab par 'ong gsung*/ nang rten 'brel byang chub kyi sems kyi bsam pa des/ gsang ba rten 'brel lus byin gyis brlabs pa/ rdo rje'i lus de nyid kun rdzob byang sems thig les gang bas lus bde ba chen po byang chub kyi sems su ro gcig pa dang*/ phyi'i snang ba thams cad sgyu mar 'char ba dang*/ lus mthong ba tsam gyi pha rol gyi zhe sdang la sogs pa zhi bar nus pa dang*/ gzhan blo gtod cing bag phebs pa dang*/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems skye bar nus pa 'byung*/ gsang ba rten 'brel byang chub kyi lus des/ phyi rten 'brel snang ba byin gyis brlabs te/ byang chub kyi thugs 'byongs pa yin bya ba'i snyan pa'i sgo nas gzhan bsnyen bkur dang zhabs tog byed pa dang*/

sems gsum la gtsor byed pa'i 'khor 'dus nas rang gi 'phrin las sgrub pa dang*/ gang du phyin pa thams cad du byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi sems can smin grol byed pa dang*/ sems bskyed zhu ba mang po 'byung ba dang*/ rin po che'i bye brag mang po 'bul ba 'byung gsung*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas sprul pa'i skur byon nas 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du mchog dang skye dman pa sprul pa'i sgo nas sems smin grol byed pa 'byung*/ yang don byed mkhan dang bya rgyu dang byas pa las byung pa'i 'bras bu gsum rang gi sems la sems stong nyid du rtogs pa ni chos sku yin la/ snang ba dang stong pa gnyis su med par bde ba chen por longs spyod pa ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin ste/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang la 'dud// ces gsungs pa yang de lta bu la zer ba yin gsung*/ ma sems can mar ma shes pa'i don dam pa byang chub kyi sems de kho na nyid ma shes pas ma rig pa/ des bdag gzhan du bzung pas las bsags nas srid pa gsum du 'khor bar shes pa'i dus su 'khor ba'i 'dug lugs shes pa yin/ des na/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// zhes gsungs pa yang de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin/ des na byang chub kyi sems gcig pu go bas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad go ba yin gsung*/ sdud pa las/ byang chub sems med rgyal 'byung 'jig rten yod med na// 'bras bu brgya byin tshangs pa nyan thos ga la 'byung*// gsungs pa yang de lta bu zhig la zer ba yin gsungs/ gnyis pa yi dam gyi lha la sems bzhag pa'i yon tan gang yin ni/ rang gi sems yi dam gyi lha rgyan cha lugs la sogs pa gsal ba'i dus su dge sbyor ci byas pa thams cad kyang lha'i rnam par 'char ba dang*/ phyi snang ba thams cad lhar 'char zhing snod thams cad gzhal yas khang du 'char ste/

de ltar rang lhar gsal ba'i dus su/ lus sems gnyis bde chen du shar ba ni bde ba la/ rang lhar gsal ba ni gsal ba/ rang sems lha'i rgyan cha lugs la sogs par gsal kyang de'i rjes su rtog pa mi 'brang pa ni mi rtog par 'ong gsung*/ yang gsal ba'i dus su tha mal dang zhe sdang la sogs pa'i rtog pa spangs pa ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ lha gsal ba'i steng du sems gnas pa ni ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ phyag mtshan la sogs pa'am rgyan la sogs pa re res 'phrin las tha dad pa 'grub par shes pa'i lha sems skye ba med par shes pa ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab par 'ong ba yin gsung*/ de ltar na nang rten 'brel sems yi dam lhar gsal ba'i bsam pa des/ gsang ba rten 'brel lus byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus su/ rdo rje'i lus la rtsa dang rlung dang*/ thig le dang yi ge dang gnas kyi tshul du lha'i rang bzhin du yod pa dang gnyis su med par gyur ste lus lha'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i dus su/ rgyud dag pa rnams kyi lhar mthong ba dang*/ spyan gzigs pa tsam gyi gdon skrag pa dngangs nus pa dang*/ mchil ma btab pas nad zhi ba dang*/ lus kyi reg pa tsam gyis gnod pa la sogs zhi ba 'byung gsung*/ gsang ba rten 'brel lus lhar snang ba des/ phyi rten 'brel snang ba byin gyis brlabs te/ yi dam lha la brtan pa thob pa yin bya ba'i sgo nas snyan bkur dang zhabs tog byed pa 'byung ba dang*/ dpa' bo dang ṭa ki thams cad dbang du 'du/ lha'i ting nge 'dzin la mno bsam byed pa'i 'khor 'dus nas 'phrin las sgrub pa dang*/ gang du phyin yang thams cad du dbang zhu ba dang*/ bskyed rdzogs zhu ba mang po byung nas gzhan don rgya chen po 'grub pa dang*/ ye shes kyi chos skyong ba thams cad dbang du 'dus nas 'phrin las bzhi yis sems can smin cing grol bar byed pa 'byung gsung*/ mtshan brjod nas/ rgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i tshul bstan pa// 'di ni rnam dag legs pa'i lam// zhes gsungs pa yang de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin gsung*/

mthar thug sangs rgyas pa'i dus su/ lha sku sna tshogs su snang zhing*/ don dam pa chos kyi skur rtogs pa ni/ chos kyi skur sangs rgyas su'o// lha'i sku bde ba chen po dang stong pa gnyis su med pa bde ba chen por longs spyod pa ni/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi skur gyur nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor snang nas/ lha dpa' bo gcig pa'i snang ba'i sgo nas dus 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du sems can gyi don du 'byung ba ni longs sku'i sangs rgyas yin te/ rdo rje 'phreng ba nas/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gnas// bar do'i grong khyer des mi mthong*// zhes gsungs pa de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin gsung*/ yang rang lhar ma shes shing tha mal du zhen pas dug gsum gyis lus ngag yid gsum gyis las bsags pas/ khams gsum skye 'chi'i du khaḥl zo chun gyi khyud mo bzhin 'khor bar go ba ni 'khor ba'i 'dug lugs go ba ste/ sdud pa nas/ ye shes tshul sgo thabs dang rtsa ba ji snyed pa// de kun shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog las byung*// zhes gsungs pa yang de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin gsung*/ de ltar go bas 'khor 'das thams cad go ba bya ba yin te/ chod de che ba yin gsung*// ༈ //gsum pa snying gi dkyil du bla ma'i steng du sems bzhag pa'i yon tan ni/ bla ma gsal zhing rang gi sems dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbye ba med par gyur te rang sems bla ma song ba'i dus su/ dge sbyor ci byas thams cad bla ma'i 'phrin las su 'char ba dang*/ phyi'i snang ba thams cad bla ma'am slob dpon du 'char la bla ma'i steng du sems gnas shing gsal dus su log rtog gi lus sems ma btses te/ lus sems bde la/ rang sems bla mar gsal ba ni/ gsal ba yin/ bla ma'i 'phrin las sna tshogs gsal kyang de'i rjes su rtog pa mi 'brang ba ni mi rtog pa'o// yang bla ma'i steng du sems gnas pa'i dus su nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa spangs pa ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la/

phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bla ma'i steng na sems gnas pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa yin/ bla ma'i 'phrin las sna tshogs shes pa'am/ bla mar 'dzin pa'i sems skye ba med par shes pa ni/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab par 'ong gsung*/ nang rten 'brel rang gi sems bla mar gsal ba'i bsam pa des/ gsang ba rten 'brel lus byin gyis brlabs te/ rang lus bla ma'i skur gyur pa'i dus su/ gzhan gyi lam sna 'dren pa'i bla ma bya bar red nas/ gzhan sangs rgyas la 'god pa'i nus pa 'byung ba dang mtshan thos pa'i gsung tsam gyi gzhan dad gus skye nus pa dang*/ dge sbyor la sogs yon tan bskyed pa dang*/ skyon 'dag nus pa 'byung*/ yang gsang ba rten 'brel lus kyi snang ba byin gyis brlabs te mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma yin bya ba'i snyan pa'i sgo nas gzhan bsnyen bkur dang zhabs tog byed pa 'byung ba dang*/ mos gus la gtsigs su byed pa'i 'khor 'dus nas/ rang gi 'phrin las sgrub pa dang*/ sangs rgyas su lta ba dang*/ gang du byon pa thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par thar pa mdzad pa thams cad kyis/ sems can smin cing grol ba'i 'phrin las gyi don 'grub pa yin gsung*/ mtshan brjod nas/ 'gro ba'i bla ma ston pa po// dam tshig chen po de nyid mkhyen// gsungs pa yang de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin gsung*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas pa'i dus su/ rang sems bla ma dag pa gnyis ldan chos kyi sku'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur la/ de'i ngang la gnas pa dang stong pa gnyis su med par bde chen du longs spyod pas longs sku'i sangs rgyas sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bla mar snang ba dang*/ tshogs lam chen po la sprul sku'i bla mar snang ba nas bzung ste lo ka'i srin bu la bung ba'i skad du chos ston pa'i bla ma'am/ ka kha slob pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas dus 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du sems can gyi don 'byung bar go ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'dug tshul lo// dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba ni/

chos gsum dang ldan pa'i rin po che// zhes gsungs pa yang de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin gsung*/ yang dang po bla ma ma gshegs bar du mos gus ma shes/ tha mar log pa'i slob dpon gyis zin te/ slob dpon gyi rten 'brel ma 'grig pas/ sred len dang las kyi du kha'i 'khrul 'khor du gyur ste/ 'khor bar 'khor ba shes pa ni 'khor ba'i 'dug tshul yin te/ sdud pa nas/ rkyen rnams 'tshogs nas sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'byung*// ma rig 'khrul 'khor 'di ni zad med 'phel ba med// ces gsungs pa yang de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin gsung*/ bla ma'i mos gus gcig pu go bas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad go ba yin te/ de yang chos chung ba min gsung ngo*// ༈ //bzhi pa phyag rgya chen po la sems ma yengs pa'i ngang du sems bzhag pa'i yon tan ni/ bla ma snga phyi'i bar de sems ma bcos pa so ma'i ngang dus der thang lhod thams cad bral bar bzhag pas/ bla mas bstan pa'i dge sbyor gcig skye ste/ de ci 'dra gcig skye na/ sems rnam par mi rtog pa gsal sing nge ba skad gcig ma tsam zhig skye ste/ de ka bla mas bstan pa'i phyag rgya chen po yin/ ngo shes par byas nas skyong dgos te/ de ka rang sems sangs rgyas chos sku yin/ sems rtog med gsal stong skad cig ma de ka sgom yin dge sbyor yin te/ de ka la bla ma tilli pas/ kye ho 'di ni rang rig ye shes te// ngag gi lam 'das yid kyi spyod yul min// tilli nga yis ci yang bstan du med// rang rig nyid la mtshon te shes par byos// zhes gsungs pa yang de la zer ba yin/ bla ma nā ro pas/ mi mno/ mi bsam/ mi sems/ mi sgom/ mi dpyad/ sems yang dag pa nyid du grol/ zhes gsungs yang de la zer ba yin gsungs/ seng ge bzang pos mngon rtogs rgyan las/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// gzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/

yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// zhes gsungs pa yang de ga la zer/ dbu ma nas/ sems ni sems min te/ sems ni rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'o// zhes gsungs pa yang de la zer/ bram ze chen po'i zhal nas/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid 'di// glod na grol bar the tshom med// ces gsungs pa yang de ka yin/ rnam snang byang chub pa'i rgyud las/ gang la brtag bya rtog byed yod// de ni byang chub yod ma yin// byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid ni// rtog pa thams cad spangs phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa yang de yin/ de dge sbyor yin sgom yin/ de khyad du mi gsad par lto gos la gyong skur nas/ dben pa bsten la skyong ba gal che gsung*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ dge sbyor skad cig ma de skyong ba yang*/ dper na me don du gnyer ba gcig gis spra ba dang me rdo dang me lcags dang skyes bu'i rtsol ba'i rten 'brel sgrig pas/ me rta dmar ba zhig byung ba de khyad du ma bsad par gso ba'i dus su/ me lce la sogs dal bus ma gsos par sa rdo btab na me de 'chi ba yin/ dge sbyor skad cig ma tsam de ma bskyang par gtum mo la sogs pa'i dge sbyor gzhan bsgoms na/ skad cig ma tsam de yal nas 'gro ba yin/ yang me de yang la sogs dal bus gsos te/ sa rdo ma btab na me de shig tsam nas la sogs pa je che je che song nas/ gzod sa rdo btab kyang nags tshal la sogs sreg pa'i grogs su 'gro ba yin/ de dang 'dra ba dge sbyor skad cig ma de rang dben pa bsten cing bskyangs te gtum mo la sogs pa dmigs pa gzhan mang po ma byas na/ dge sbyor skad cig ma gcig dang gnyis la sogs par rgyun je ring je ring song nas goms pa'i dus su/ gtum mo la sogs dge sbyor gang bsgoms kyang phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du lhan lhan 'gro ba gcig yong ba yin/ gsung*/ yang me chung ngu re rlung chen po gcig gis bus pas 'chi ba yin/

de dang 'dra bar dge sbyor brtan pa ma thob pa de la nyon mongs pa la sogs pa'i rtog pa phra bas kyang gnod pa yin/ yang me chen po 'bar ba'i dus na rlung chen po byung na yang nags tshal sreg pa'i grogs su 'gro ba yin/ de dang 'dra bar dge sbyor la brtan pa thob pa'i dus su nyon mongs pa la sogs pa'i rtog pa ci byung yang*/ dge sbyor de'i grogs su 'gro ste/ nags tshal sregs pa'i me la rlung chen po yang grogs su 'gyur/ skyes bu ye shes spyan la nyon mongs grogs su 'gyur bya ba de la zer ba yin gsung*/ 'di rtse gcig gi dge sbyor yin gsung*/ rang bzhin ngo bo mtshan nyid gsum las 'di sems kyi rang bzhin gsal ba/ ston gyi nam mkha' dag pa lta bu de la rnam par rtog pas go ma 'gags pa zhig yong*/ sems can rnam rtog spongs la sems mi rtog pa de me long g.ya' dag pa ltar gsal ba gcig 'ong ste/ de ga la gsal stong nam mkha' mtha' dbus med par gsungs pa yin/ nyams su myong ba mngon pa rtog pa gsum las en cig bla ma nyams su len mdzad pa yin/ nyams bde ba gsal ba mi rtog pa gsum las dge sbyor de'i ngang la gnas pa'i dus su lus yang zhing zo mdog bde ba dang*/ sems nyon mongs pa la sogs pa'i rtog pas dben zhing bde sing nge 'dug pa ni bde ba yin/ yang sems rtog pas stong pa'i ngang las sing nge gsal ba'am/ de'i ngang nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams la sogs pa gsal ba ni gsal ba yin/ mi rtog pa de'i dus su sems stong pa'am/ dbang po lnga'i yul lnga gsal kyang de dag gi rjes su rtog pa mi 'brang pa ni mi rtog pa yin/ nyams 'di khrid byed pa'i bla ma min pa la bshad na yal 'gro ba yin pas mi bshad pa gal che gsung*/ yang mtshan bcas sam mtshan med kyi dge sbyor gang la yang gnad du bsnun pa'i dus su/ mnyam rjes gang yang rung ste skyon dang yon tan gang byung yang*/ da 'di las byung 'dug snyam pa shes pa de nyams myong bya bar 'ong ba yin zhing dngos po bsam pa gsum las/

rtse gcig gi dus su 'dir snang sems gnyis la dbang ma thob pas/ zhing gis sgyur bas zhing gtso che ba yin gsung*/ de yang rdzas dang lus dang nyams gsum la zhen pa bor nas dben pa bsten cing rtse gcig gi dge sbyor bskyangs pas/ de las bogs thon nas spros bral gyi dge sbyor 'char te/ dge sbyor rtse gcig 'di'i ngang nas bla ma'i byin rlabs gcig dang rang gi mos gus kyi shugs kyi sems skye 'chi med pa spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba rang gi sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi skur lhan gyis rtogs te/ sems kyi rtsa ba chod pa zhig 'byung ba de spros bral gyi dge sbyor yin/ 'di la rtogs par mdzad de sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba yin gsung*/ ngo bo de yang skye 'gag gi chos thams cad dang bral ba zhig yin/ rtogs pa des nyon mongs pa mngon du rgyu spangs pas lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab par 'ong la/ sems skye 'chi med pa'i ngang du gnas pa dang*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje skye ba'i ngos nas/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab par 'ong ba yin/ sems skye med rtsa bral du rtogs pa de'i ngang nas chos spyi bye brag thams cad sha mo'i sul che ba'am/ rgyu 'bras ma 'dres par mkhyen pa ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab par 'ong gsungs so// de ltar rang gi sems chos skur rtogs pa'i dus su dge sbyor ci byas pa thams cad phyag rgya chen po skye ba med pa 'char zhing*/ snang ba thams cad chos skur 'char ba yin/ nang rten 'brel bsam pas gsang ba rten 'brel lus byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus su/ rang gi lus 'od dam 'ja' tshon lta bu gcig tu gyur te/ rang gi lus gzhan gyi mthong ba'am mtshan thos pa'i gsung thos pa tsam gyis/ yid chags pa dang gzhan gyi sems kyi mdud pa grol bar nus shing rtogs pa skye bar nus pa dang*/ dge sbyor skye bar nus pa 'byung*/

tshig gis smon lam btab pa dang bden pa thams cad 'grub pa dang*/ rab gnas byas pa'i dus su me tog 'chags pa dang*/ chos mang po 'bul ba 'byung ba dang*/ khyad par du ratna'i glegs bam mang po 'bul ba yong ba yin gsung*/ yang gsang ba rten 'brel lus des phyi rten 'brel snang ba byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus su rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba yin zhes pa'i sgo nas bsnyen bkur dang zhabs tog dpag tu med par byed pa 'ong*/ snying po'i don gtsigs su byed pa'i 'khor 'dus nas rang gi don sgrub pa 'byung ba dang*/ gang du byon pa thams cad du bdag med pa'i seng ge'i sgras sems can smin grol byed pa 'byung gsung*/ 'jam dpal nas/ don zab don ni rgya che zhing*// don chen mtshungs med rab zhi ba// zhes pa yang de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin gsung*/ zhing dngos po bsam pa gsum las/ spros bral gyi dus su/ bsam pa gtso che ba yin te/ zhing rang gi sems kyis byed par go bas yin gsung*/ 'o na spros bral rtogs pa yin na/ nyams dang rtogs pa'i khyad par gang yin snyam na/ rtse gcig gi dus na nges shes ma skyes te/ sems kyi rtsa ba ma chod pas/ bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum la rloms sems zhen pa yod la/ spros bral gyi dus na rang gi sems skye 'chi med par rtogs te nges shes skyes pas sems kyi rtsa ba chod pa'i stobs kyis nyams la sogs pa la rloms pa'am/ zhen pa'i mkhan po med par rtogs pas rtogs par 'ong ba yin gsung*/ 'o na lta ba dang rtogs pa'i khyad ci yin na/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas bka' brgyud rin po che 'di la lta ba med pa yin gsung*/ 'o na yang lta ba'i mchog bla ma la sangs rgyas su lta ba ma gtogs pa gzhan med/ 'on kyang spyi tsam gyi dbang du byas na thos bsam gyi sgo nas/ chos thams cad skye ba med par 'dug snyam pa'i snyam tsam gyi shes pa dang bral ba de lta ba yin la/

snyam byed kyi shes pa dang bral ba'i shes pa de rang skye 'chi med par skye med dang lhan gyis rtogs pa de la rtogs pa zer ba yin gsung*/ de la dgongs nas chos rjes/ grub mtha' blo'i mdun ma la// sangs rgyas dgongs pa 'khrul pa yin// lar ma go ba la ston par zad// 'di 'dra gcig bya ba'i brjod pa thams cad dang bral ba gcig yin gsung*/ 'o na mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob kyi khyad par gang yin zhe na/ rje rin po che zhal nas/ spyi tsam gyi dbang du byas na/ stan la 'dug rung 'gro yang rung ste mtshan ma can nam mtshan ma med pa'i dge sbyor gyi steng na sems gnas pa de mnyam bzhag yin/ 'gro yang rlung stan la 'dug kyang rung ste/ de dag las gzhan pa'i rtog pa skye ba de mnyam langs yin la/ rje rin po che bzhed kyi de dang khyad par gyi chos yin pas/ sems rnam par mi rtog pa de mnyam gzhag yin la/ de'i rjes snang ba thams cad mi bden pa sgyu mar 'char ba ni rjes yin te/ des mis phyin pa la mi'i rjes 'ong ba dang 'dra gsung*/ kha cig mi rtog pa'i rjes chags sdang skye ba de la rjes yin zer te/ de mi 'thad/ de ltar song na mis phyin pa'i rjes la spre'u'i rjes byung ba dang 'dra gsung*/ 'o na gang yin na nyon mongs pa de sa bon ma rig pa bag la nyal mi gsal ba'i tshul du rgyud la yod/ chags sdang de de'i rjes yin gsung*/ mchog gsum las 'chi ba la dbang ma thob pas mchog chung ngu yin/ rgya gsum las spros bral gyi rtog pa des rnam rtog rtsa bral du rtogs pas rtog pa'i rgya las grol ba yin gsung*/ spros bral gyi dge sbyor de yang zhen pa gsum btang nas ri khrod la sogs la goms par byas pas/ de las kyang bogs thon ste ro gcig gi rtogs pa 'char te/ ji lta bu gcig 'ong na/ snang ba dang sems gnyis su med par rtogs/ yul yul can gnyis su med par go snang stong gnyis med du shes te zung 'jug gi rtog pa 'khrungs pa yin gsung*/

'o na spros bral dang*/ ro gcig gi khyad par gang yin snyam na/ spros bral gyi dus na sems stong par rtogs kyang snang ba stong par ma rtogs la/ rgyu 'bras bag tsam go yang rgyu 'bras mtha' dag ma go/ nyon mongs par rags pa spangs kyang mngon du rgyu bag re skye/ skye ba la dbang thob kyang 'chi ba la dbang ma thob/ ro gcig gi dus su snang sems gnyis su med par rtogs/ nyon mongs pa mngon du rgyu mi skye/ skyes kyang dge sbyor 'char/ 'di sems kyi mtshan nyid yin pas 'khor 'das du mar snang zhing rgyu 'bras mtha' dag go/ skye 'chi gcig gnyis ka la dbang thob/ ro gcig gi dus su mnyam pa nyid rtogs pas dngos po gtso che/ zung 'jug rtogs pas mchog 'bring po 'ong ste/ rtogs pa de'i ngang du lus 'od dam 'ja' lta bur 'byongs te/ lus shul du ma lus te 'chi rgyu med pas skye 'chi gnyis ka la dbang thob ste ra dza ind+ra bhu ti'am/ bram ze chen po lta bu yin gsung*/ de ltar zung 'jug tu song bas lus rgya las grol te/ mchog 'bring po yin gsung*/ ro gcig de yang spros med dam shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa brten cing goms par byas pas/ sgom med kyi rtogs pa 'char te/ sems gdod ma nas stong zhing rnam par dag pa dang*/ ro gcig man chad kyis nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog rkyen glo bur gyi dri ma dag par byas pas yin/ bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral zhing mnyam rjes med pa'i dag pa gnyis ldan dri med chos kyi sku'i sangs rgyas su 'char ba chu la chu bzhag pa'am mar la mar bzhag pa ltar/ chos kyi skur sangs rgyas te rang bzhin gyi don 'grub par byas pa yin gsung*/ mchog gsum las 'di mchog chen po yin/ snang ba rab chod pas snang ba'i rgya las grol ba yin gsung*/ 'o na ro gcig dang sgom med kyi khyad gang yin snyam na/ ro gcig gi dus su myong ba cha phra mo zhig yod/

sgom med kyi myong ba cha phra mo zhig rtsa ba nas spangs te dri ma med/ snang ba thams cad gnyis med kyi ngang du zhi/ mnyam gzhag 'ba' zhig yin glang chen bzhugs kyang mnyam bzhag la/ bzhengs kyang mnyam par bzhag pa bya ba yang de ka la zer ba yin gsung*/ 'khor ba'i sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa rtsa ba nas spangs ste/ spong ba phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan dang*/ ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan mnga' zhing*/ sku gsum ye shes lngar sangs rgyas pa yin te/ me long g.ya' dag pa la gzugs brnyan gsal ba dang 'dra bar/ chos sku dag pa gnyis ldan du sangs rgyas te de ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin/ de ltar chos kyi sku dag pa gnyis dang ldan pa de'i ngang nas/ sems can gyi khams dang bag la nyal dang bsam pa'i tshogs thams cad dang rgyu 'bras thams cad ma 'dres par mkhyen pa ni ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin la/ yang rang don chos kyi sku rtogs pa'i bdag rkyen dang gdul bya gyen du phyogs pa'i gzhan rkyen dang*/ sngon du thabs goms par byas pa'i rten 'brel gsum 'dzoms pa la brten nas/ sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sangs rgyas su byon nas don byed pa dang*/ tshogs lam man chad rnams la mchog dang skye ba dman pa'i sprul pa sna tshogs su byon nas/ dus 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du rtag pa dang khyab pa dang rgya che ba dang*/ rgyun mi 'chad par sems can gyi don 'byung ba ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'dug lugs yin/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs pa// sangs rgyas sku gsum ngo mtshar che// zhes gsungs pa yang de lta bu gcig la zer ba yin gsung*/ yang sems can gyi de kho na nyid de rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa bskyed pa'i ma yin te/ de ma shes pa ni ma rig pa yin/ ma rig pa de las snang ba gsum 'byung ste/ de yang snang ba las ma rig pa las gyur pa'i rtog pa bdun 'byung*/

mched pa las gyur pa'i rtog pa sum cu so gnyis 'byung*/ nyer thob las 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rtog pa bzhi bcu 'byung ste/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam par bsten nas bdag gzhan du 'byung*/ der chags sdang gnyis kyis lus ngag yid gsum gyi las bsags nas/ srid pa'i rtse mo nas mnar med kyi bar du rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi tshul du 'khor bar 'khyams par shes pa yin te/ mdo las/ bdag gzhan cha las 'dzin dang sdang*// de gnyis dang ni 'brel ba las// nyes pa thams cad 'byung ba yin// zhes gsungs pa'i tshul yin gsung*/ de 'khor ba'i 'dug lugs yin te/ phyag rgya chen po gcig pu go bas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad go ba yin te/ de yang chos chung ba min gsungs/ klu sgrub kyis/ stong pa kho na'i chos rnams la// stong pa kho na skye bar zad// 'gro kun rgyu dang 'bras bu ste// 'di las sems gzhan ci yang med// ces gsungs pa'am/ chos rjes/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// gsungs pa yang de lta bu la zer ba yin gsung*// ༈ //lnga pa bsngo ba la sems bzhag pa'i yon tan gang yin snyam na/ dmigs pa med pa'i bsngo ba bya ste/ sems sngo ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i dus su/ dge sbyor ci byas pa thams cad bsngo ba'i rnam par 'char ba dang*/ bsngo ba'i snang ba thams cad bsngo ba'i byed las su 'char ba 'byung*/ yang bsngo ba 'grub pa'i dus su lus sems bde ba ni bde ba la/ bsngo ba'i rnam pa gsal ba ni gsal ba yin la bsngo ba bsngo'o// rgyu bsngos pa gsum gsal kyang de'i rjes su rtog pa mi 'brang ba ni mi rtog pa yin gsung*/ yang bsngo ba byed pa'i dus su zhe sdang la sogs rtog pa spangs pa ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab par 'ong*/ bsngo ba'i rnam pa la sems gnas pa ni lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa/ zhing bsam dngos po gsum rang gi sems/

sems stong par rtogs pa ni shes rab kyi bslab pa yin gsung*/ nang rten 'brel bsngo ba'i bsam pa des/ gsang ba rten 'brel lus byin gyis brlabs ste/ lus de bsngo ba byed pa'i dus su gzhan gyi dge ba mi 'dzad pa'i gter du sbed pa'i snang ba 'byung*/ gsang ba rten 'brel lus dogs pa phyi rten 'brel snang ba byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus su/ bsngo ba la gtsigs su byed pa yin zhes pa'i sgo nas gzhan bsnyen bkur byed pa 'byung ba dang*/ bsngo ba la so nam byed pa'i 'khor 'dus nas/ rang gi don sgrub pa dang*/ gang du phyin pa thams cad du bsngo ba'i 'phrin las kyis sems can smin grol byed pa 'byung gsung*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas pa'i dus su sprul sku gsum gyi dus 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du sems can gyi don rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba ni sprul pa'i sku yin/ 'khor gsum mi rtog pa'i mi dmigs pa stong nyid du rtogs pa ni chos kyi sku yin la/ zung 'jug gnyis su med pa'i bsngo bas snang ba dang stong pa gnyis su med par bde chen du longs spyod pas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sangs rgyas yin te/ mdo las/ thabs dang shes rab rkang gnyis gshog pa brkyang byas nas// gar 'dod sar phyin bde ba'i gnas thob 'gyur// zhes pa yang de lta bu la zer ba yin gsung*// yang bsngo ba ma shes pa'am/ shes kyang mi dmigs pa'i bsngo bas ma zin pas/ 'khor bar 'khyams par shes dus su bsngo ba'i go bas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad go nus pa yin te/ de chos zab pa yin gsung*/ sdud pa nas/ ji ltar dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas bzang za ba// dkar po'i chos la dmigs pa'ang de 'drar rgyal bas gsungs/ gsungs pa yang de lta bu la zer ba yin gsung*/ de nas lnga ldan lta bu gcig la gnad du bsnun pa'i dus su 'khor 'das kyi chaus thams cad go nas 'ong ba yin te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/

'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'du byed de// de phyir mkhas pa 'du mi byed// ces pa dang*/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon yin// zhes pa dang*/ bag chags dag las byung bas na// bag chags sa bon dag tu bshad// bag chags rjes mthun 'tshogs pa na// srid pa'i myu gu des skyed de// zhes gsungs pa yang de lta bu la zer ba yin gsung*/ de rnams kyis ku su lu sgro 'dogs nang nas gcod pa'i lugs/ bla ma'i rgya rdog po re re la nan tan du byas byas pas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad go nus pa/ lus 'di tsug sdod la/ sems 'di tsug zhog dang*/ yon tan 'di 'dra zhig skye yis bya ba'i gsung rin po che la brten pa'i chos gcig snyan du gsol ba lags/ da bsngo ba mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ sngon dbyangs dal 'byor sdong po la// bslab gsum dri med yal ga can// dran shes mos gus lo 'dab rgyas// byang chub me tog 'bras ldan pa'i// gus bsten slob mas zhus pa yin// gsum tshan bcu yi man ngag 'di// bkod pa'i dge ba rgya mtsho'i des// 'gro kun lnga ldan rab brten nas// mi shes sdug bsngal spangs nas kyang*// ye shes lnga ldan rdzogs sangs rgyas// sku lnga dbyer med rdo rje 'chang*// 'gro mgon bla ma rin chen gyis// sku yi bkod pa gar bzhugs su// mtha' yas ye shes spyod nus shog /'gyur med mos gus ting 'dzin gyis// sku gsung thugs gsang mdzod 'dzin shog /'gro mgon rje yi bka' drin gyis// dgos 'dod nor bu sems la rnyed// chags sdang gnyis kyi sdos thag bcad// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi re dogs bral// ro mnyam ngang nas byang sems 'phel// mnyam bzhag nang du gzhan don rdzogs// lha dang rang sems dbyer med pas// gcig pur bsdad kyang 'phrin las rgyas// zhen med chos sku'i mos gus kyis// rang sems rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor bde// mad kyang sku re bgyis pa lags// 'gro mgon rje yi gsung bzhin bkod// 'di la 'gal 'khrul mchis srid na// nyams rtog ldan la bzod par gsol// slob dpon pad mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/
